label: Wise: KRW receiving limit, non-resident recipient
appliesTo: Individuals not confirmed as Korean residents receiving personal transfers in KRW through Wise
why: The number most often mistaken for a Korean legal ceiling on inbound transfers. It is a provider limit on one settlement route, applying to recipients who are not confirmed as residents — a category many new arrivals fall into before registration completes, which is precisely when they are receiving set-up money from home and least expecting a cap.

history.display: USD 5,000 per transfer, USD 50,000 a year
history.source: Wise — KRW receiving limits for Korean recipients
history.note: Per-transfer and annual limits for recipients not confirmed as residents, on person-to-person transfers. Not a statutory figure: a bank transfer over SWIFT is governed by the foreign exchange regulations rather than by this. Someone expecting a large arrival before their residency is established should check the route before sending, not after.
